root.description: The id of the root the path is under

path.description: The member's package.json, relative to its root

dir.description: The member's directory, relative to its root; `.` for the workspace root

name.description: The `name` field (the last occurrence when repeated), or null when absent, not a string, or the file has no rows

version.description: The `version` field, or null when absent, not a string, or the file has no rows

private.description: The `private` field, or null when absent, not a boolean, or the file has no rows

workspaceRoot.description: Whether this is the root package.json that declares the workspace

projection-workspace-packages.description: A row of the derived `workspace_packages` relation
